args.query: zod v3 to v4 migration: z.string().email() deprecated, message param renamed to error, error.flatten() and format() replaced, z.record needs a key schema

results.title: Zod v4 schemas exported to JSON Schema and checked with Ajv
results.summary: Export Zod v4 schemas to JSON Schema 2020-12 with z.toJSONSchema, using .meta() ids and descriptions and input vs output modes, then validate the same data with Ajv 2020.

results.title: ws WebSocket server with a Zod-validated message protocol
results.summary: A room chat server on the ws library with token auth on the upgrade URL, a Zod 4 discriminated union for every inbound frame and typed error replies, tested offline with real ws clients on an ephemeral localhost port.

results.title: Zod 4 schemas to an OpenAPI 3.1 document with zod-to-openapi
results.summary: Register Zod 4 schemas, path and query parameters, security schemes and routes in an OpenAPIRegistry and generate an OpenAPI 3.1 document (JSON and YAML) from the same schemas used for runtime validation, tested offline.

results.title: Koa 3 REST API with @koa/router, Zod validation and supertest
results.summary: A Koa 3 JSON API using @koa/router and @koa/bodyparser with Zod 4 body and param validation mapped to 400 responses by a central error middleware, tested offline with supertest.

results.title: NestJS Zod ValidationPipe for body DTOs
results.summary: Validate NestJS request bodies with a reusable Zod ValidationPipe that returns 400 field errors, tested through @nestjs/testing and supertest without relying on emitDecoratorMetadata.

results.title: gray-matter front matter parsing validated with Zod
results.summary: Parse Markdown front matter with gray-matter, validate and coerce it with a Zod v4 schema, read excerpts and write posts back with matter.stringify.

results.title: LangChain.js tools with Zod schemas and a manual tool-calling loop
results.summary: Define LangChain.js tools with tool() and Zod schemas, run model tool_calls through them, and feed ToolMessages back, tested with a scripted fake chat model.

results.title: Croner cron jobs from a Zod-validated config, with timezone previews
results.summary: Validate a job config with Zod 4 (cron pattern checked by croner, IANA timezone, unique names), preview upcoming runs across DST and month ends with croner nextRuns, and start protected jobs with maxRuns, tested offline.

results.title: better-sqlite3 transactions with Zod-validated inputs
results.summary: A small ledger on better-sqlite3 using db.transaction for atomic transfers, nested transactions as savepoints for all-or-nothing batches, and Zod 4 to validate inputs and rows, tested on in-memory SQLite.

results.title: React Hook Form + Zod 4 resolver schemas (no DOM)
results.summary: Share one Zod schema between React Hook Form (via @hookform/resolvers) and the server, with cross-field refinements, tested by calling the resolver directly.
